messages:
tara: Noticed aggregate p99 for /v1/complete jumped after we enabled route-merge policy. p50 unchanged, p95 up ~150ms. Console shows two endpoint slices but no origin metadata.

ben: Do you have counts? small-slice can dominate p99 if it has a heavy tail.

tara: yes: endpoint X count=4800 p99=110ms, endpoint Y count=90 p99=620ms, aggregate p99=615ms. That feels misleading for customers looking at "overall" latency.

ops-bot: Alert #L-789 triggered: high-p99-rollup at 2026-03-21T08:12:20Z.

rui: This is the tdigest rollup effect. We currently store only the merged digest. Proposal: store per-endpoint digest meta (count + origin tag) so we can show provenance and compute alternate merges.

design-ana: UX suggestion: show a tiny provenance pill next to percentiles listing top origins + counts (sdk/gateway/cache). Add "weighted" toggle to prefer volume-weighted p95/p99.

ben: Implementation path: 1) persist per-endpoint tdigests and counts (non-breaking), 2) expose API param `merge_mode=weighted|append`, 3) console toggle defaulting to append for backward compatibility.

tara: Agreed. Also request we change alert payload to include per-endpoint p95/p99 and counts so alerts are actionable.

ops-bot: Task created: METRICS-212 add endpoint digest metadata. Assigned to rui.

rui: I'll open PR with schema change and tests reproducing tiny heavy-tail flip. ETA: Tue.

design-ana: I'll wire a small prototype and tooltip text: "Append merge may reflect small high-tail slices. Toggle to Weighted to reflect dominant traffic"

ben: Important: do NOT change default semantics without migration plan. We'll keep historical aggregates intact and make weighted an opt-in read-time behavior.

tara: Sounds good. That should reduce noisy pages. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
